verdict.rationale: Google publishes a device compatibility table: Android and iOS via NFC, with iPhones on iOS 13.3+ listed as supported. Linux setup is documented (a udev rule may be needed), and community users confirm the keys work with Firefox on Linux without Google software. Cross-browser support is mixed: one user hit a 'Chrome only' error on a Mac, and the Bluetooth key could not be paired with a Mac. Google gives no catalog of supported services, only a generic statement that the keys work on any site supporting FIDO CTAP1. Missing for 10: a published compatibility catalog of supported third-party services, a documented browser support matrix across OSes, and consistent macOS/browser behavior.
